builder-transcript.note: Withheld from what the runtime hands the target: each trial runs in a disposable workspace that leaves out the evaluation folder, and every request carries only the interaction plan's literal bindings and the values its captured bindings read from the target's own earlier observations in the same trial. The runtime does not sandbox the target's file system, so a target that searches for the evaluation folder can reach it.
